items.title: Mayer-Vietoris distinguished triangle for the derived pushforward along the inclusions of two open subspaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a ringed space X which is the union of two open subspaces U and V, the lemma produces a distinguished triangle relating an arbitrary object E of the derived category to the derived pushforwards of its restrictions to U, V and the intersection (statement lines 8118-8131). The proof chooses a K-injective representative whose terms are injective modules, so that the derived pushforwards along the three open inclusions are computed by the corresponding pushforwards of the restricted complexes; this reduces the statement to the distinguished triangle associated to a short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 8133-8153). The remaining point is exactness of that sequence of complexes, which is checked termwise: for every open W and every degree n the sequence of sections over W, W cap U, W cap V and W cap U cap V is exact, exactly the combinatorial statement used in the Mayer-Vietoris proof (proof lines 8154-8163). The claim is H2: one adjunction-free reduction plus a termwise exactness check, with no step left to the reader beyond the cited exactness.
